record.title: Manufacturing schedule throughput
record.body: Current-run repository manufacture directly authored 4 meaningful quality-at-source commits on R78: two deterministic SPARQL projection repairs plus two permanent regression/standard-work guards. R78 workstream total is now 78 commits on PR #315; the pre-existing 74 are not relabeled as current-run authorship. The admissible portfolio is 3 workstreams (R78,R76,R74) but the PRE ready set contained only R78. The 50-commit floor is therefore not met by direct current-run authorship because exact broad real-GGEN qualification repeatedly exposed dependency-ordered canonical defects; manufacturing 46 unrelated commits while the selected READY producer remained BUILD_BROKEN would violate downstream pull and legality-before-priority. Attempted envelope 100+ through open portfolio/repository universe; two admissible non-ready workstreams preserved. Same-cell Project control commits are tracked separately from semantic repository commits.
